introduction: This spec fixes the premature issue-closing bug in nightshift's PR mode and extends the `afissues` platform protocol with PR lifecycle types, query methods, and a structured tracking comment system for end-to-end PR state management.

glossary.CheckResult: Frozen dataclass representing a single CI check-run result, including name, status, conclusion, and output fields.
glossary.GitHubPlatform: Concrete platform implementation in `afissues.github` that calls the GitHub REST API via the `_request()` helper.
glossary.IntegrationError: Exception class in `afissues.errors` raised by platform methods on unrecoverable API failures.
glossary.LabelSpec: Dataclass or named structure in `afissues.labels` describing a label's name, color, and description for bootstrap creation.
glossary.NullPlatform: No-op platform implementation in `afissues.protocol` used when platform type is `none`; raises `NotImplementedError` for PR-related methods.
glossary.PR_TRACKING_PATTERN: Module-level compiled `re.Pattern` in `fix_pipeline.py` that matches the machine-readable tracking comment HTML tag.
glossary.PlatformProtocol: Abstract protocol class in `afissues.protocol` defining the interface all platform implementations must satisfy.
glossary.PrResult: Frozen dataclass returned by `create_pr()` containing `html_url` (str) and `number` (int) for the created pull request.
glossary.PrState: Frozen dataclass representing the current state of a pull request: number, state string, merged flag, and head SHA.
glossary.REQUIRED_LABELS: List of `LabelSpec` objects in `afissues.labels` that the bootstrap routine uses to ensure all labels exist in the repo.
glossary.ReviewComment: Frozen dataclass representing a single pull request review, including user, state, body, and submitted_at timestamp.
glossary._handle_result: Async method on `FixPipeline` that applies labels, posts comments, and optionally closes the issue based on integration status.
glossary._integrate_fix: Async method on `FixPipeline` that executes the fix strategy and returns a status string plus list of changed files.
glossary._request: Internal async helper method on `GitHubPlatform` that handles auth headers, retries, and rate limiting for GitHub REST API calls.
glossary.af:fix: GitHub issue label indicating the fix pipeline is actively working on the issue.
glossary.af:fixed: GitHub issue label applied when a fix has been fully merged; triggers issue close.
glossary.af:pr: GitHub issue label indicating an associated pull request has been created and is awaiting merge; part of the nightshift label lifecycle.
glossary.af:pr-tracking: HTML comment tag prefix embedded in tracking comments to make them machine-readable by `PR_TRACKING_PATTERN`.
glossary.attempt: Integer field in the tracking comment HTML tag indicating which fix attempt created the associated pull request; always 1 in this spec.
glossary.fix_pipeline.py: Module `agentfox.nightshift.fix_pipeline` containing `FixPipeline`, tracking comment utilities, and the `PR_TRACKING_PATTERN` constant.
glossary.format_tracking_comment: Module-level function in `fix_pipeline.py` that formats a machine-readable tracking comment body string.
glossary.get_pr_checks: New async method on `PlatformProtocol` and `GitHubPlatform` returning a list of `CheckResult` for a given PR number.
glossary.get_pr_reviews: New async method on `PlatformProtocol` and `GitHubPlatform` returning a list of `ReviewComment` for a given PR number.
glossary.get_pr_state: New async method on `PlatformProtocol` and `GitHubPlatform` returning a `PrState` for a given PR number.
glossary.head_sha: The Git commit SHA at the tip of the pull request's source branch, used to look up CI check runs.
glossary.idempotent 422 path: Recovery branch in `GitHubPlatform.create_pr()` where a 422 response from GitHub (PR already exists) triggers a lookup of the existing open PR.
glossary.merge_strategy: Configuration field on the workspace that determines how fixes are integrated; `"pr"` mode creates a pull request instead of merging directly.
glossary.output_summary: Field on `CheckResult` holding the summary string from a GitHub check run's output object; empty string when GitHub returns null.
glossary.output_title: Field on `CheckResult` holding the title string from a GitHub check run's output object; empty string when GitHub returns null.
glossary.parse_tracking_comment: Module-level function in `fix_pipeline.py` that extracts `(pr_number, attempt)` from a tracking comment body, or returns `None`.
glossary.pr_created: Integration status string returned by `_integrate_fix()` when a pull request has been successfully created but not yet merged.
glossary.self._pr_number: Instance attribute on `FixPipeline` of type `int | None` that stores the PR number after successful `create_pr()` for use by `_handle_result()`.
glossary.session_lifecycle.py: Module `agentfox.nightshift.session_lifecycle` that calls `create_pr()` and must be updated to use `result.html_url`.
glossary.submitted_at: Field on `ReviewComment` holding the raw ISO 8601 timestamp string as returned by the GitHub API.

glossary.\"af:pr\": String value of the LABEL_PR constant

requirements.title: Add af:pr label constant and bootstrap entry

user_story.goal: have the af:pr label automatically created in the repository at startup
user_story.benefit: so that the label is always available before the fix pipeline runs and creates pull requests

acceptance_criteria.action: defines `LABEL_PR` as the string constant `"af:pr"` and includes a `LabelSpec` entry in `REQUIRED_LABELS` with color `#1d76db` and description `"Pull request created — awaiting merge"`
reads `REQUIRED_LABELS` and creates the `af:pr` label in the repository if it does not already exist, using color `#1d76db`
re-exports `LABEL_PR` so callers can import it from the top-level `afissues` package

edge_cases.action: propagates the error via `IntegrationError` and halts startup rather than silently continuing with a missing label
edge_cases.error_condition: the GitHub API returns an error when creating the `af:pr` label

requirements.title: Define PrResult, PrState, CheckResult, and ReviewComment dataclasses

user_story.goal: have typed, immutable dataclasses for all PR-related API responses
user_story.benefit: so that downstream code can rely on structured data instead of raw dicts and avoid None-handling complexity

acceptance_criteria.action: defines `PrResult` as a frozen dataclass with fields `html_url: str` and `number: int`
defines `PrState` as a frozen dataclass with fields `number: int`, `state: str`, `merged: bool`, and `head_sha: str`
defines `CheckResult` as a frozen dataclass with fields `name: str`, `status: str`, `conclusion: str | None`, `output_title: str`, and `output_summary: str`
defines `ReviewComment` as a frozen dataclass with fields `user: str`, `state: str`, `body: str`, and `submitted_at: str` holding the raw ISO 8601 string as returned by the GitHub API
maps the null output to `output_title=""` and `output_summary=""` on the resulting `CheckResult`, keeping both fields as non-optional strings
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a GitHub check-run API response contains `output: null`

acceptance_criteria.action: re-exports `PrResult`, `PrState`, `CheckResult`, and `ReviewComment` so all four are importable from the top-level `afissues` package

edge_cases.action: raises `FrozenInstanceError` from the dataclass machinery, preventing accidental mutation
edge_cases.error_condition: code attempts to mutate a field on any of the four frozen dataclasses after construction

requirements.title: Extend PlatformProtocol with get_pr_state, get_pr_checks, and get_pr_reviews

user_story.goal: have typed async methods to query PR state, CI check results, and review comments
user_story.benefit: so that the follow-on pr_feedback_loop spec can build on a stable, typed interface without knowing platform implementation details

acceptance_criteria.action: declares `async def get_pr_state(self, pr_number: int) -> PrState` as an abstract protocol method
declares `async def get_pr_checks(self, pr_number: int) -> list[CheckResult]` as an abstract protocol method
declares `async def get_pr_reviews(self, pr_number: int) -> list[ReviewComment]` as an abstract protocol method
implements `get_pr_state`, `get_pr_checks`, and `get_pr_reviews` each by raising `NotImplementedError`, consistent with `NullPlatform.create_pr()`

user_story.goal: query the open/closed/merged status and head SHA of a pull request by number
user_story.benefit: so that the system can determine whether a PR has been merged before closing its associated issue

acceptance_criteria.action: sends `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pr_number}` using `_request()` and maps the response to a `PrState` with `number`, `state`, `merged`, and `head_sha` fields
delegates error handling to `_request()`, which raises `IntegrationError`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the GitHub API returns a non-2xx status

edge_cases.action: raises `KeyError` or `IntegrationError` rather than silently returning a partially populated `PrState`
edge_cases.error_condition: the GitHub API response body is missing the `state`, `merged`, or `head` fields

edge_cases.action: relies on `_request()` timeout and retry logic; if all retries are exhausted, raises `IntegrationError` without hanging the caller indefinitely
edge_cases.error_condition: the GitHub API call times out or hangs

requirements.title: Implement get_pr_checks on GitHubPlatform with pagination

user_story.goal: retrieve all CI check-run results for a pull request
user_story.benefit: so that the pr_feedback_loop spec can report CI failures back to the issue without knowing internal GitHub API details

acceptance_criteria.action: first fetches the PR via `get_pr_state(pr_number)` to obtain `head_sha`, then sends `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{head_sha}/check-runs` using `_request()`, and maps each check run in the response to a `CheckResult`
paginates through subsequent pages using `_request()` until all check runs are collected, accumulating results across pages
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns `list[CheckResult]` containing all check runs across all pages
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the GitHub API response `total_count` exceeds the page size

acceptance_criteria.action: sets `output_title=""` and `output_summary=""` on the resulting `CheckResult`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a check-run entry in the API response has `output: null`

edge_cases.action: raises `KeyError` or `IntegrationError` rather than returning a partial list
edge_cases.error_condition: the check-runs API response is missing `check_runs` or `total_count` fields

edge_cases.action: delegates to `_request()` error handling, raises `IntegrationError`, and does not return a partial list
edge_cases.error_condition: the GitHub API returns an error on any page request during pagination

edge_cases.action: may stop at 10 pages at the implementer's discretion and return all check runs collected so far, without raising an error
edge_cases.error_condition: pagination produces more than 10 pages of results (more than 300 check runs)

user_story.goal: retrieve all review verdicts and comments for a pull request in submission order
user_story.benefit: so that the pr_feedback_loop spec can surface review feedback to the issue author without platform-specific logic

acceptance_criteria.action: sends `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pr_number}/reviews` using `_request()` and maps each review to a `ReviewComment` with `user`, `state`, `body`, and `submitted_at` fields in submission order
returns reviews in the order they appear in the GitHub API response without filtering by state; the caller is responsible for filtering dismissed or irrelevant reviews

edge_cases.action: raises `KeyError` or `IntegrationError` rather than silently omitting the review or using a default value
edge_cases.error_condition: the GitHub API response is missing `user.login`, `state`, `body`, or `submitted_at` fields on a review object

edge_cases.action: delegates to `_request()` error handling and raises `IntegrationError`
edge_cases.error_condition: the GitHub API returns a non-2xx status

requirements.title: Change create_pr() return type from str to PrResult

user_story.goal: receive a structured PrResult containing both the PR URL and PR number from create_pr()
user_story.benefit: so that the PR number can be stored and used in tracking comments without fragile URL parsing

acceptance_criteria.action: declares `create_pr()` with return type `PrResult` instead of `str`
extracts `html_url` and `number` from the response body and returns `PrResult(html_url=data["html_url"], number=data["number"])`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the GitHub API returns a successful 201 response for PR creation

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?head={owner}:{branch}&state=open` using `_request()`, takes the first result, and returns `PrResult(html_url=..., number=...)` extracted from that matched PR
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns `PrResult` with `html_url` and `number` from the existing PR
acceptance_criteria.trigger: GitHub returns a 422 response indicating the PR already exists

acceptance_criteria.action: accesses `result.html_url` where it previously used the bare string return value
accesses `result.html_url` for logging and `result.number` for the tracking comment

edge_cases.action: raises `IntegrationError` rather than returning a `PrResult` with missing fields
edge_cases.error_condition: the GitHub 422 recovery lookup returns an empty list (no matching open PR found)

edge_cases.action: raises `KeyError` or `IntegrationError` rather than returning a partially populated `PrResult`
edge_cases.error_condition: the successful 201 response body is missing `html_url` or `number` fields

requirements.title: Fix premature-close bug: _integrate_fix returns pr_created for PR mode

user_story.goal: have issues with open pull requests remain open until the PR actually merges
user_story.benefit: so that issues are not incorrectly closed with af:fixed before CI passes and a human reviewer approves

acceptance_criteria.action: returns the tuple `("pr_created", changed_files)` after calling `create_pr()` successfully, instead of the previous `("merged", changed_files)`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns `tuple[str, list[str]]` where first element is `"pr_created"`

acceptance_criteria.action: initializes `self._pr_number: int | None = None` as an instance attribute
sets `self._pr_number = result.number` before returning the `"pr_created"` status tuple
allows the exception to propagate without setting `self._pr_number`, so `_handle_result()` is never called with `"pr_created"` and no partial state is exposed

edge_cases.action: relies on `_request()` timeout handling; if the timeout fires, `create_pr()` raises `IntegrationError`, which propagates out of `_integrate_fix()` without setting `self._pr_number`
edge_cases.error_condition: `create_pr()` call times out or hangs due to a network issue

requirements.title: _handle_result applies af:pr label and leaves issue open for pr_created status

user_story.goal: have _handle_result apply the af:pr label, remove af:fix, post a tracking comment, and leave the issue open when the status is pr_created
user_story.benefit: so that the issue lifecycle accurately reflects PR creation and does not incorrectly reach a closed state

acceptance_criteria.action: adds the `af:pr` label to the issue, removes the `af:fix` label, posts the structured tracking comment, and leaves the issue open without calling any close API
skips label mutation calls as an optimization (since the GitHub API treats them as no-ops) and still posts a new tracking comment to ensure a complete audit trail
acceptance_criteria.state: called with status `"pr_created"` and `af:pr` is already present on the issue

acceptance_criteria.action: does not apply `af:fixed` and does not close the issue when status is `"pr_created"`

edge_cases.action: raises `IntegrationError` via `_request()` error handling without leaving the issue in a partially labeled state that could trigger premature close
edge_cases.error_condition: the GitHub API call to add `af:pr` label fails with a non-2xx response

edge_cases.action: raises a descriptive `RuntimeError` or `AssertionError` because this state is a programmer error — `_pr_number` must be set before `"pr_created"` can be returned

requirements.title: Tracking comment utilities: PR_TRACKING_PATTERN, format_tracking_comment, parse_tracking_comment

user_story.role: fix pipeline and follow-on pr_feedback_loop spec
user_story.goal: have module-level utilities for formatting and parsing machine-readable PR tracking comments
user_story.benefit: so that both the initial PR creation and subsequent feedback iterations can share a stable, testable comment format

acceptance_criteria.action: defines `PR_TRACKING_PATTERN` as a compiled `re.Pattern` matching `<!-- af:pr-tracking pr_number=(\d+) attempt=(\d+) -->` at module level

defines `format_tracking_comment(pr_number: int, attempt: int, pr_url: str, message: str) -> str` that returns a string beginning with the HTML comment tag `<!-- af:pr-tracking pr_number={pr_number} attempt={attempt} -->` followed by the human-readable message line
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns a `str` with the HTML comment tag on the first line and the message on the second line

acceptance_criteria.action: defines `parse_tracking_comment(body: str) -> tuple[int, int] | None` that uses `PR_TRACKING_PATTERN` to search the body string and returns `(pr_number, attempt)` as integers, or `None` if no match is found
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns `tuple[int, int]` if a match is found, or `None` if no tracking comment tag is present

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `format_tracking_comment(pr_number=self._pr_number, attempt=1, pr_url=result.html_url, message=f"Pull request created: {result.html_url}")` and posts the result as a new comment on the issue
exposes `PR_TRACKING_PATTERN`, `format_tracking_comment`, and `parse_tracking_comment` as importable module-level symbols so the follow-on `pr_feedback_loop` spec can import them directly

edge_cases.action: returns the `(pr_number, attempt)` from the first match found by `PR_TRACKING_PATTERN.search()`
edge_cases.return_contract: returns `tuple[int, int]` from the first match
edge_cases.trigger: called with a body string containing multiple tracking comment tags
called with an empty string or a string containing no tracking comment tag

execution_paths.title: Happy path: fix pipeline creates PR, applies af:pr label, leaves issue open

steps.action: triggers nightshift to process an issue with `merge_strategy` set to `"pr"`
calls `GitHubPlatform.create_pr()` which returns `PrResult(html_url=..., number=42)`; sets `self._pr_number = 42`; returns `("pr_created", changed_files)`
receives status `"pr_created"`; adds `af:pr` label and removes `af:fix` label on the GitHub issue
calls `format_tracking_comment(pr_number=42, attempt=1, pr_url=..., message="Pull request created: ...")` and posts the formatted comment on the issue
returns without calling any close API; the GitHub issue remains open with the `af:pr` label
observes the issue is still open, labeled `af:pr`, with a machine-readable tracking comment linking to the PR

execution_paths.title: Idempotent retry: _handle_result called with af:pr already on issue

steps.action: nightshift retries processing an issue after a partial failure that already applied `af:pr`
calls `GitHubPlatform.create_pr()` which returns the existing `PrResult` via the idempotent 422 path; sets `self._pr_number`; returns `("pr_created", changed_files)`
detects `af:pr` already present on the issue; skips label mutation calls as an optimization
posts a new tracking comment regardless, ensuring a visible retry record in the issue history
observes the issue still open and labeled `af:pr` with an additional tracking comment showing the retry

execution_paths.title: Protocol consumer queries PR state, checks, and reviews via GitHubPlatform

steps.action: calls `GitHubPlatform.get_pr_state(pr_number=42)` to determine if the PR is still open
sends `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/42` via `_request()` and returns a `PrState` with `state`, `merged`, and `head_sha`
calls `GitHubPlatform.get_pr_checks(pr_number=42)` to retrieve CI results
fetches `head_sha` from `get_pr_state()`, then sends `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{head_sha}/check-runs` via `_request()`, paginates if needed, and returns `list[CheckResult]`
calls `GitHubPlatform.get_pr_reviews(pr_number=42)` to retrieve review comments
sends `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/42/reviews` via `_request()` and returns `list[ReviewComment]` in submission order
receives typed, immutable dataclasses for all three queries with no need to handle raw API dicts

execution_paths.title: Bootstrap ensures af:pr label exists before pipeline runs

steps.action: starts the nightshift service
reads `REQUIRED_LABELS` from `afissues.labels`, finds the `af:pr` entry with color `#1d76db`
calls the GitHub API to check for existing labels; creates `af:pr` if it does not exist in the repository
observes that `af:pr` label is present in the repository and the pipeline proceeds normally
